surfaces.name: Termic desktop app (macOS, Linux AppImage, Windows experimental)

claims.answer: Desktop app: macOS 12+ (universal), Linux x86_64 AppImage, Windows 11 x64 (experimental). The termic CLI and an MCP endpoint drive the running app; a phone companion is planned only. No browser client and no editor extension.

evidence.title: termic.dev
evidence.finding: Free and open source (AGPL-3.0), runs locally with no account or backend; spawns real agent CLIs in PTYs; downloads for macOS, Linux AppImage and Windows 11 x64 (experimental).

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 335 stars, license reported as AGPL-3.0, homepage termic.dev, not archived, pushed 2026-11-16.

evidence.title: Termic README
evidence.locator: headline; Install; What it does; Sandbox; Status; Roadmap; License
evidence.finding: Desktop app running real claude, codex, agy, copilot, grok, opencode, pi, omp, Muse, Devin and Cursor CLIs in separate git worktrees with optional macOS Seatbelt or Docker sandbox, Kanban board, diff review, PRs, CLI and MCP server, schedules, LAN pairing; macOS 12+, Linux AppImage, Windows experimental; AGPL-3.0-or-later; roadmap lists mobile app, Apple Containers, Linear and opt-in telemetry as planned.

evidence.title: GNU AGPL v3
evidence.locator: header; Cargo.toml and package.json license fields
evidence.finding: GNU Affero General Public License v3 text; package.json, src-tauri/Cargo.toml and termic-cli/Cargo.toml declare AGPL-3.0-or-later.

evidence.title: Package manifest
evidence.finding: Frontend on React with xterm.js terminals and Tauri 2 API; license AGPL-3.0-or-later.

evidence.title: Tauri backend manifest
evidence.locator: tauri 2 with tray-icon, notification, dialog plugins; license
evidence.finding: Rust backend on Tauri 2 (native webview) with notification and dialog plugins; license AGPL-3.0-or-later.

evidence.title: Changelog
evidence.finding: Dated shipped changes per release; 1.23.0 adds agent-driven pairing, batched PR status polling and crash log helpers.

evidence.title: Sandbox design
evidence.locator: Seatbelt; Docker mode; YOLO interaction; Settled
evidence.finding: Per-task macOS Seatbelt cage with network allowlist proxy; Docker mode container cage (experimental, egress not restricted); YOLO auto-on inside cages; Secrets roles.

evidence.title: Every state an agent tab can be in
evidence.finding: Agent states working, working with delegated work, done, attention, interrupted derived from hooks and PTY signals; bell on done and attention.

evidence.title: Windows
evidence.locator: status and Not on Windows yet
evidence.finding: Windows 11 x64 experimental: NSIS installer, not Authenticode-signed, Docker mode is the sandbox, some features missing.

evidence.title: LAN pairing
evidence.finding: Experimental pairing of computers on one network with a four-digit code; agents can drive tasks on the peer; off by default.

evidence.title: Agent accounts
evidence.finding: Several logins per agent in separate folders; switch a task mid-conversation; Termic never sees credentials.

evidence.title: Adding an agent
evidence.finding: Editable agent registry for custom PTY agents beyond the built-ins.

evidence.title: Driving Termic from an agent
evidence.finding: Instructions block and runtime discovery for agents to use the termic CLI; caged agents are excluded; termic help --json lists every command.

evidence.title: Data model
evidence.finding: Local JSON state (projects.json, tasks/, settings.json) in the app data directory and global peers.json written 0600.

evidence.title: Agent customizations
evidence.locator: skills, MCP servers and personas per profile
evidence.finding: Skills, MCP servers and personas kept per profile and added to tasks for claude, codex and agents reading .agents/.

evidence.title: MCP idea notes
evidence.finding: Phase A MCP endpoint shipped in 1.0.0; scoped per-task tokens are an undecided idea.

evidence.title: MCP server
evidence.locator: tools_list; task_new, task_send, task_wait, task_result, task_review, schedule_*, peer_*
evidence.finding: MCP tools mirror the CLI verbs: task_list/status/new/review/send/wait/result/log/diff/archive, scratchpad_*, project_*, schedule_*, peer_*; bearer-token authentication and Host/Origin checks.

evidence.title: CLI control plane
evidence.locator: local socket server for the termic CLI
evidence.finding: Control-plane server behind the termic CLI: new, tab, send, status, wait and more over a local socket.

evidence.title: termic CLI
evidence.finding: termic CLI with documented verbs, JSON and stream-json output, exit codes and attach/detach.

evidence.title: Schedules
evidence.finding: Recurring and one-off scheduled runs with catch-up for missed slots; each run is a new task.

evidence.title: Forge integration
evidence.finding: PR/MR status and creation for GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps through each forge CLI sign-in.

evidence.title: Seatbelt sandbox implementation
evidence.finding: Generates Seatbelt profiles and runs the hostname-allowlist CONNECT proxy; macOS only.

evidence.title: Docker sandbox implementation
evidence.finding: Runs agents in a container as the host user with capabilities dropped and a PID cap.

evidence.title: Process monitor
evidence.locator: per task CPU, memory, output rate
evidence.finding: Activity view data: CPU, memory, output rate and uptime for each agent, shell and run script.

evidence.title: Agent usage windows
evidence.finding: Reads provider plan usage windows for the footer and optional account switch at 95 percent.

evidence.title: Secrets roles
evidence.finding: Experimental secrets: agent holds a placeholder and Termic swaps the real credential for allowed hosts and API calls.

evidence.title: Agent hooks
evidence.finding: Installs small hooks into agent configs so tab states come from the agent.

evidence.title: Repository config
evidence.finding: Setup, run scripts, preview URLs and sandbox allowlists loaded from a committed .termic.yaml.

evidence.title: Bounded search: users, roles and SSO
evidence.locator: grep -Eni saml|oidc|rbac|sso|multi-user over src, src-tauri/src, docs, README
evidence.finding: No accounts, roles, SSO or multi-user collaboration; the only multi-machine feature is the pairing of one person's computers.

evidence.title: Bounded search: vendor cloud, mobile and headless
evidence.locator: grep -Eni hosted|vendor cloud|ios app|android app|headless over src-tauri/src, README, docs/ideas
evidence.finding: No vendor cloud and no headless server; the mobile app (#165) and headless boxes (#82) are planned or idea-stage only.

evidence.title: Bounded search: telemetry
evidence.finding: No telemetry sender exists; README lists opt-in usage telemetry as a planned item, off by default; only local crash logs exist.

evidence.title: Bounded search: native issue tracker
evidence.locator: grep -Eni issue tracker|backlog|priority|labels over src, src-tauri/src
evidence.finding: No native issue entity with priority or labels; tasks are worktree tasks and Todos lists GitHub/GitLab issues and PRs.

evidence.title: Bounded search: living specifications
evidence.locator: grep -Eni living spec|requirements|drift over README, docs, src
evidence.finding: No persistent requirements or drift detection; docs/plans and docs/ideas are repository docs for Termic itself.

evidence.title: Bounded search: spend, token and time limits
evidence.locator: grep -Eni max budget|spend limit|token limit|timeout over src-tauri/src, docs
evidence.finding: No product spend, token or time cap; plan usage windows are informational with an optional switch to another login at 95 percent.
